title: T&T- Customer - M&C - Manager | Adobe Commerce | Bengaluru | Marketing & Commerce
description:
**T\&T\- Customer \- M\&C \- Manager \| Adobe Commerce \| Bengaluru \| Marketing \& Commerce**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 112403
* **Location**: Bengaluru
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

  



Customer has to do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long\-term growth. Learn more about: Customer

  



**Key Responsibilities:**

  



We are looking an experienced Business Analyst with strong expertise in Adobe Commerce (Magento) to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams. The ideal candidate will be responsible for gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, driving solution design discussions, and ensuring successful delivery of Adobe Commerce\-based eCommerce initiatives.



The candidate should possess a deep understanding of eCommerce processes, Adobe Commerce capabilities, customer journeys, integrations, and agile delivery methodologies.

  


* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and development teams to gather and analyze business requirements.
* Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead requirement workshops, stakeholder discussions, and solution walkthrough sessions.
* Evaluate current business processes and identify opportunities for optimization and automation using Adobe Commerce capabilities.
* Work closely with UI/UX, development, QA, and integration teams to ensure business requirements are accurately implemented.
* Define and manage product backlogs, prioritize requirements, and support sprint planning activities.
* Conduct gap analysis and recommend best\-fit Adobe Commerce solutions.
* Support integration requirements involving ERP, CRM, Payment Gateways, OMS, PIM, and third\-party applications.
* Facilitate UAT planning, execution, and sign\-off processes.
* Prepare business process documentation, BRDs, FRDs, wireframes, workflow diagrams, and training materials.
* Track project risks, dependencies, and scope changes while ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Ensure solution compliance with eCommerce best practices and industry standards.

  


**Functional Skills:**

  


* Strong experience as a Business Analyst within eCommerce programs.
* Hands\-on experience with **Adobe Commerce (Magento 2\)** implementations and enhancements.
* Strong understanding of:
* Catalog Management
* Product Information Management (PIM)
* Inventory Management
* Pricing \& Promotions
* Checkout \& Order Management
* Customer Account Management
* Payment \& Shipping Integrations
* B2B Commerce Features
* Multi\-site / Multi\-store implementations
* Experience in requirement elicitation, process mapping, and gap analysis.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  


**Technical Understanding:**

  


* Good knowledge of Adobe Commerce architecture and platform capabilities.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, GraphQL, integrations, and middleware platforms.
* Understanding of ERP/CRM integrations such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.
* Knowledge of digital commerce ecosystems and headless commerce concepts is preferred.
* Familiarity with analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and reporting dashboards.

  


**Agile \& Delivery:**

  


* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Expertise in creating:
* User Stories
* Use Cases
* Acceptance Criteria
* Process Flows
* Functional Specifications
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.

  


**Qualifications:**

  


* 7\-10 years of Business Analysis experience.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience working on Adobe Commerce/Magento projects.
* Certifications in Adobe Commerce, Agile, Scrum, CBAP, or related disciplines are a plus.

  


**Preferred Skills:**

  


* Adobe Commerce Business Practitioner knowledge.
* Experience in omni\-channel retail and B2B commerce implementations.
* Exposure to Headless Commerce, PWA Studio, Adobe Experience Cloud, or Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* Knowledge of customer journey mapping and digital transformation initiatives.

  


**Success Metrics:**

  


* Accurate and complete requirement documentation.
* Reduced requirement\-related defects and rework.
* Successful delivery of Adobe Commerce releases/projects.
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction and business adoption.
* Efficient backlog management and sprint execution.

  


**Must Have:**

  


* 7\-10 years BA experience
* Adobe Commerce (Magento 2\)
* eCommerce domain expertise
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience
* Requirement gathering, BRD/FRD/User Stories
* Stakeholder management

  


**Good to Have:**

  


* AEM / Adobe Experience Cloud
* Adobe Analytics
* Headless Commerce
* SAP/Salesforce integrations
* B2B Commerce experience

  


**Location and way of working:**

  


* Base location: Bengaluru
* Education: Professional Qualification \- B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MBA/MS
* This profile involves occasional travelling to client locations.
* Hybrid is our default way of working. Each domain has customized the hybrid approach to their unique needs.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
We are seeking a data\-driven and results\-oriented **Performance Marketing Manager** to lead our paid acquisition and growth marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience managing **multi\-channel digital campaigns, optimizing marketing spend**, and driving **measurable business outcomes through analytics and experimentation**.

You will be responsible for **planning, executing, and optimizing campaigns** across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other **performance marketing channels to maximize ROI, customer acquisition, and revenue growth**.

Key Responsibilities

* **Develop, execute, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across:**
* **Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max)**
* **Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram)**
* **LinkedIn Ads**
* Other paid media channels as applicable
* Manage monthly advertising budgets and ensure efficient allocation of spend.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize based on KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CPL, CAC, CTR, and conversion rates.
* Conduct A/B testing on ad creatives, landing pages, audiences, and campaign structures.
* Collaborate with content, design, product, and sales teams to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Build and maintain dashboards using Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, and other reporting tools.
* Analyze customer journeys and identify opportunities for growth and conversion optimization.
* Implement and manage tracking, attribution, and conversion measurement systems.
* Stay updated on digital advertising trends, platform updates, and industry best practices.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or growth marketing.
* Proven experience managing paid campaigns with measurable ROI.
* **Strong expertise in:**
* Google Ads
* Meta Ads Manager
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
* Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Experience with conversion tracking, attribution models, and marketing analytics.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Lead Volume and Quality
* Conversion Rate
* Revenue Growth
* Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

title: Manager - Product Marketing - Bangalore
description:
**Function/Group:**
Marketing :
**Experience:**
5\-8yrs
**Location:**
India
**About Tally**
The pioneers of software product industry in India, we are a technology and innovation led company simplifying the lives of small and medium businesses over the last three decades. With our cutting\-edge technology, we have had the privilege to reach over 2\.5 million business globally and cater to more than 7 million users in over 100 countries. We are passionate about the SMEs’ growth and aim to deliver the best for their business through our product innovation and excellence. Our teams develop some of the most ingenious solutions that suit the unique requirements of millions of businesses across the globe. With a market share of 75% in India, we have a strong foothold in the Middle East and are also serving customers in SAARC \& APAC, Africa, and North America. Our robust network of 28000\+ partners help us deliver unmatched customer experience in sales, support, and services globally.  

With a sole purpose of Making Everyone Who Touches Tally, Happier, we aim to be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world, by 2030\.


**Culture \& Values**
Over the years, we have nurtured a value\-based culture that let individuals follow their lead and support them in their growth journey with us. We value honesty and integrity, prioritize a people\-first culture, pursue excellence, and drive impactful innovation with simplicity.  

Our vision at Tally is to ensure that all employees get access to equal opportunities, with decisions grounded on performance, merit, competence, and potential. We are dedicated to fairness and transparency in our policies. By fostering diversity and equality, we strive to eliminate all forms of discrimination. We are committed to an inclusive leadership where our leaders ensure that our people are empowered to be at their best, professionally, and personally. We take great pride in our work culture which has helped become a proud member of the elite Kincentric Best Employers Club!


**Marketing**
Marketing at Tally is a strategic, business\-enabling function that fuels innovation, builds consistency, and strengthens our market presence. Guided by our core pillars of like, Customer Connect, Integrated Marketing Digital and Brand Marketing, we craft initiatives that resonate with our audiences and reinforce our brand promise. We focus on creating impactful initiatives across Branding, Customer Marketing, and Partner Marketing to ensure strong engagement, lasting value and drive business growth.



For us at Tally, brand marketing goes beyond visibility. It’s about building trust, simplifying complexity, and championing businesses of all sizes. As India’s most loved business management software, Tally holds a unique position, one that blends deep legacy with contemporary relevance.


### **We believe in**


* **Integrated Marketing:** Leveraging all channels by maintaining uniformity of brand voice, visuals, and messaging.
* **Customer Centricity:** Placing the customer at the heart of all marketing efforts.
* **Brand Stewardship:** Custodian of Employer Branding.
* **Marketing with purpose, not noise:** Supporting business growth with value driven communication.


**What You Will Own**
As a Product Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for driving deeper engagement, adoption, and value realization among our existing customer base. This is a customer\-first role sitting at the intersection of product marketing, customer success, content, and lifecycle marketing. You will translate product capabilities and customer insights into compelling content, stories, and campaigns that help customers unlock greater value from the product.


**Where Your Expertise Meets Our Future**
* 5\-8 years of experience in product marketing, customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, content marketing, or a related role.
* Strong experience marketing to an existing customer base.
* Excellent storytelling, content, and communication skills.
* Experience developing customer testimonials, case studies, videos, and success stories.
* Strong understanding of email, lifecycle, and mid\-funnel marketing.
* Ability to simplify products and turn features into compelling customer value.
* Strong customer interviewing and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable using data to measure and improve marketing effectiveness.
**The Scope of Your Influence****Customer Storytelling \& Content**


* Build a strong pipeline of customer testimonials, case studies, success stories, and videos.
* Identify compelling customer stories in partnership with Customer Success, Sales, and regional teams.
* Interview customers and turn their experiences, challenges, and outcomes into engaging stories.
* Develop content across videos, email, articles, use cases, and other formats.
* Build a library of customer proof points that can be used across marketing, sales, and customer communications.


**Customer Marketing \& Adoption**


* Develop campaigns that drive adoption of products, features, and capabilities among existing customers.
* Translate product features into clear, relevant “why this matters to you” messaging.
* Identify customer needs, use cases, and adoption barriers, and build marketing programs around them.
* Create targeted communications for different customer segments and levels of product maturity.


**Mid\-Funnel \& Lifecycle Marketing**


* Own customer\-facing communications and nurture programs that move customers from awareness to consideration and action.
* Build connected customer journeys rather than one\-off campaigns.
* Use customer stories and proof points to make communications more relevant and persuasive.
* Test and optimize messaging, content, and journeys based on performance.


**Cross\-functional \& Insights**


* Partner closely with Product, Customer Success, Sales, Creative, and Analytics teams.
* Bring customer insights into product marketing and communications.
* Measure engagement, adoption, and campaign effectiveness, and continuously improve programs.
